GetResponse is best for teams that want newsletters, automation, landing pages, forms, ecommerce workflows, and unlimited email sends on paid plans.

The platform offers all the marketing tools you need to build and scale email campaigns. Not only that, but it provides solutions to support marketing campaigns across other channels, including paid media, SMS marketing, and push notifications. [...] GetResponse offers a transactional email service dedicated to these campaigns. The service is offered as an add-on to our Max plans. It delivers all your order confirmations, shipping alerts, receipts, and password reset email campaigns within one second. You can send these campaigns through an SMTP or API connection. [...] GetResponse’s email marketing solution offers a suite of tools to support everything from building your list to recovering lost sales and nurturing customer loyalty.

Lead generation tools, like a landing page creator, as well as a signup and pop-up form builder, are included in our plans. The drag-and-drop landing page creator is super easy to use. It’s also powered by AI, which makes it easier for anyone, even folks with no coding skills, to create high-converting landing pages fast.
